onboarding.welcomeText: We help you keep track of supplies and agree with your family on a plan for when things stop working. Calmly, step by step.
onboarding.householdTitle: How many of you are there?
onboarding.locationText: Name the first place. You can add more later.
onboarding.meetingText: If phones stop working, your family should know where to meet. You can pin it on the map later.

more.remindersText: We remind you 30 and 7 days before items expire.
more.remindersPlus: Expiry reminders are part of Plus.
more.remindersDenied: Notifications are turned off in phone settings.
more.disclaimer: 72h is a preparedness aid, not an official warning system. In an emergency call 112.

compare.title: Country comparison
compare.intro: Government recommendations differ. Choose your country and what the checklist should be based on.
compare.legend: ✓ recommended without amount · – not listed · ⚠️ uncertain. Official government sources only.

map.emptyText: Download the area around your home. The map then works without signal or internet.
map.longPressHint: Long-press the map to add a meeting point.
map.locationDenied: Location is off. The map works, you just won't see where you are.
map.meetingPlus: More meeting points are part of Plus.

mapAreas.sizePlus: Larger areas are part of Plus.
